summary: Reviewed owner's 13-page uploaded Kyna Business English Beginner 1A LC4 (2.1) 'My favourite holiday destination (Part 1)' PDF. Produced comprehensive Vietnamese Markdown notes for A1-A2 / pre-class practice: /mnt/data/kyna_lc4_2_1_my_favourite_holiday_destination_complete_study_notes.md (27 sections, about 1397 lines). Includes page-based recap and checked answer keys for pages 2,4–10, descriptions of weather icons as worksheet examples rather than current conditions, 10 weather adjectives, key questions Who/What/How, 20 sentence frames, 30 potential teacher Q&A, 10 dialogues, 4 example stories, speeches of 30/45/60 seconds, shadowing, common error correction, exercises with answer key, flashcards and 30-minute plan. Explicitly labels material added beyond PDF.
